data.one_liner: Customizable touch ripple effect widget providing smooth touch animations in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a performant, highly flexible touch ripple effect widget supporting tap, double tap, long tap, drag, and asynchronous callbacks. It allows external control and global styling via inherited widgets.
use_when: You need custom touch ripple animations that go beyond standard Material InkWell capabilities.
You require handling async tasks with visual ripple persistence until completion.
avoid_when: You only require standard Material design ink responses without extra customization.
Targeting platforms where touch animations are unnecessary.
strengths: Supports multiple gesture types including tap, double tap, long tap, and drag.
Highly customizable behaviors, blur, scaling, and shapes.
Provides asynchronous tap handling with state locking.
weaknesses: Limited documentation on some advanced properties.
Hover effects are not yet called in touch-based environments.

TouchRipple(
  onTap: () => print("Hello, World!"),
  child: ... // <- this your widget
